newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT -Realty Income price target up.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT -Realty Income price target up.

text.p: -- EVEREN Securities Inc said on Wednesday it raised its intermediate price target for Realty Income Corp to $25.00 a share from $23.50 and its long-term target to $26.50 from $24.
-- Rating remains intermediate market performer and long-term outperformer.
-- Realty Income recently acquired 37 retail properties for $27.5 million. The transaction is immediately accretive, EVEREN said.

-- Based on an "optimistic acquistion scenario," EVEREN raised its 1997 funds from operation estimate by $0.02 a share to $2.31. The estimate does account for $70 million in acquisitions that management is comfortable with, EVEREN said.
-- Shares were trading unchanged at 24-1/8 in late morning exchange trade.
